chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Ḥammād, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about drying oneself with a cloth before it dries, and he said: “There is no problem with it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to dry oneself with a towel before the water of wudu (ablution) dries naturally?
ai.summary: This hadith states that wiping with a cloth after wudu (ablution), before the moisture dries on its own, is permissible. It is a concise fiqh ruling concerning ritual purity and the manners related to wudu (ablution).
